ayahOccurrences.text: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine plural (form IV) imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يُوفِضُونَ is in the derivative form: يُوفِضُون
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/ف/ض   w–f–ḍ leather base for a grinding stone, place where water gathers, leather bag; mixture of people, rabble; to hurry, to speed up, to chase; to go separate ways. Of this root, يُوفِضُون yūfiḍūn, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يُوفِضُون yūfiḍūn [imperf. of v. IV أَوْفَضَ ʾawfaḍa, intrans.] to speed up, to run fast, to hasten, to rally

(70:43) كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَى نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ as if they are rallying to a flag.
